name: Zimran
title: Abraham's son by Keturah
summary: Zimran was the firstborn son of Abraham and his other wife (or concubine) Keturah. He is mentioned in the genealogies in Genesis and 1 Chronicles. Zimran is regarded as the ancestor of an Arab people, although little is known about his later life beyond his place in Abraham's lineage.

keyEvents.title: The birth of Zimran
keyEvents.description: Zimran was born as the firstborn son of Abraham and Keturah. He is the first mentioned in the list of their six sons.

keyEvents.title: Abraham's Inheritance Distribution
keyEvents.description: Abraham gave everything he owned to Isaac, but gave gifts to the sons of his concubines, including Zimran, and sent them eastward, away from Isaac.

keyEvents.title: The Death and Burial of Abraham
keyEvents.description: After Abraham's death, he was buried by his sons Isaac and Ishmael. Zimran and the other sons with Keturah had already been sent away.

keyEvents.title: Zimran in the Genealogies of Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Zimran is mentioned again in 1 Chronicles as part of Abraham's lineage through Keturah, confirming his place in biblical history.
